Each row is retained one-to-one with its live name and weight and classified as an Aave or Compound protocol position over the tracked USDC or USDT underlying. The classifications add the lending-market failure domain without weakening the canonical stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources establish that EUSD's reserve contracts hold positions in Aave and Compound lending protocols, but they do not establish a legal custody wrapper, bankruptcy remoteness, provider allocation, or a separate offchain custodian. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the reserve positions are supplied into lending markets by design.
